collisions.holding_interval: [entry,exit); unresolved hold extends to window end; delayed outcome does not extend physical occupancy
collisions.loss_semantics: EX_POST final losses among overlapping holds, and losses known at exactly the same outcome timestamp. Not intrahold MTM or pre-entry features.

descriptive_distribution.regime_zero_day_denominator: UNKNOWN: no full-market regime timeline in trade-only ledgers

input_manifest.source_window_semantics: Nine independent flat rolling windows (8 x 30 days + 5 days); historical source gaps retained; used DEV, not fresh OOS.

cost.additional_reserve_semantics: Frozen p95 absolute funding reserve on surviving 0.9 notional at inferred UTC 8h settlement, inclusive endpoints, no credits. Scenario, not historical actual funding.

sources.source_time_semantics: Historical bar close availability model; delivery latency not observed.

limitations: 151-row style union is a count of stored lifecycle entries, not jointly executable opportunities.
Daily known-Net bins include outcomes of carry-in positions; summary economics use entries inside the window and wait for outcomes. Current baseline has no carry-ins.
Concurrent-loss details use cost1x; cost2x economics and realized DD are separate, without a cost2x concurrent-loss claim.
No source-price download or price-path replay; empty dates mean no saved entries, not proved absence of tradable signals.
Explicit independent opportunity IDs are required to certify independent counts; names/time clusters alone are proxies.
Cost1x/2x are inherited frozen cost/reserve scenarios, not verified historical funding or account returns.
Zero/negative periods retained. Descriptive months, hours and regimes must not become retrospective winner whitelists.
Candidate ranking requires standalone cost-adjusted economics/independent validation, shared additional Net/entries/dates and loss/DD; no invented weighted score or correlation cutoff.

opportunities.limitation: Same-symbol/side/time clusters ignore strategy names. Saved admitted/closed rows do not enumerate rejected, unavailable or counterfactual opportunities.

K_versus_S.limitation: No selection or greedy merge. Nonoverlap refers only to saved same-symbol holding intervals; capital, cross-symbol risk, missed/new entries and shared-state exits remain unmeasured.
